name: 44094 · Willoughby, OH
findings: ZIP 44094 (Willoughby) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44094 (Willoughby) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44094 (Willoughby) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
